meta.description: Receives HOT lead data (from Lead Scoring workflow or scripts/enqueue-hot-leads.js) and appends to outreach-tracker tab in LEADS_SHEET_ID Google Sheet. SETUP: 1) Create tab 'outreach-tracker' in the leads Google Sheet with columns: lead_email, first_name, last_name, company, job_title, industry, additional_info, linkedin_url, score, touch_sent, status_after, sent_at, next_send_at, enqueued_at. 2) Configure GOOGLE_SHEETS_CREDENTIAL_ID. 3) Activate workflow and note the webhook URL for use in scripts/enqueue-hot-leads.js
